tools.name: agent_receipt_purchase
tools.description: Execute a verifiable agent-to-agent purchase end-to-end: buyer agent locks ssUSD in OrderEscrow, sequencer commits VES events, STARK proof attests order_total ≤ policy cap, SetRegistry anchors the commitment + proof on Set Chain L2, buyer marks delivered, seller releases. Returns the signed Agent Receipt JSON with on-chain tx hashes. Requires the local stack (anvil + sequencer + postgres + deployed contracts) to be running, configured by AGENT_RECEIPT_DEMO_DIR.

tools.name: agent_receipt_status
tools.description: Read the on-chain escrow state for an order. Returns buyer, seller, amount, deadlines, delivery receipt hash, and current status (None / Locked / Delivered / Disputed / Released / Refunded).

tools.name: agent_receipt_dispute
tools.description: Buyer raises an on-chain dispute on a Delivered order. Funds freeze in escrow until the operator resolves. The plain-text reason is hashed (keccak256) and stored on-chain as proof of the filing.

tools.name: agent_receipt_resolve
tools.description: Operator (sequencer / arbiter) resolves a Disputed order. Routes the locked funds either to the seller (in_favor_of_seller=true) or refunds the buyer (false). Emits DisputeResolved + Released/Refunded.

tools.name: agent_receipt_fx_quote
tools.description: Read a fresh FX quote from the on-chain FxOracle and convert an amount between currencies. Pair format: "BASE/QUOTE", e.g. "EUR/ssUSD" or "JPY/ssUSD". Returns the rate, freshness, and the converted amount. Use this BEFORE locking funds so the agent can verify the rate is fresh and within expected bounds. Pre-seeded pairs at deploy time: EUR/ssUSD, GBP/ssUSD, JPY/ssUSD, MXN/ssUSD.

tools.name: agent_receipt_merchant_statement
tools.description: Aggregate every emitted receipt in a directory into a single platform settlement statement: GMV, marketplace fees earned, FX exposure by currency, dispute outcomes, compliance bundle counts, and a sampled on-chain audit pass rate. Optional filters scope the statement to a date range, a specific seller wallet, or a specific buyer wallet — enabling multi-tenant accounting on a single OrderEscrow contract.

tools.name: agent_receipt_request_payout
tools.description: Initiate a fiat payout from the seller's SSDC balance to their bank via the off-ramp bridge. Auto-handles SSDC.approve idempotently, signs a canonical payout-request message with the seller's wallet key, POSTs the signed request to the bridge, and returns a Stripe-Treasury-shaped OutboundPayment intent. Requires bridge running on http://localhost:4243 (or BRIDGE_PAYOUT_URL env).

tools.name: agent_receipt_audit
tools.description: Independently audit a StateSet commerce receipt against the live chain. Re-verifies on-chain claims (escrow status, registry batch commitment, STARK proof metadata) and — for compliance bundles — runs the Winterfell verifier on every policy proof. Returns a structured pass/fail summary the calling agent can act on. The strongest audit primitive in the stack: any agent can verify any receipt without trusting the producer.

tools.name: agent_receipt_sweep_yield
tools.description: Operator/marketplace sweeps the rebasing yield surplus held by OrderEscrow to a recipient. With the production SSDC stablecoin, this is the T-Bill yield earned by escrowed funds while orders were in flight — a programmable platform revenue stream alongside any BPS fee. Read first via yield_available; positive amount returns the sweep tx, otherwise a no-op.

tools.name: agent_receipt_refund
tools.description: Buyer recovers locked funds after the order's deliveryDeadline has expired. No dispute, no operator, no platform — purely the safety property of the OrderEscrow primitive. Reverts with DeadlineNotReached if the deadline has not yet passed.

tools.name: agent_receipt_release
tools.description: Seller pulls escrowed funds after delivery + confirmation window. Use this when agent_receipt_purchase was called with skip_release=true and there has been no dispute. Routes funds to the seller wallet.

tools.name: simulate_inventory_experiment
tools.description: Evaluate one to three inventory policies across shared seeds through independent native embedded stores. Demand may be sampled or an explicit daily forecast schedule. Supplier lead times and first fills may be fixed, sampled or explicit dailyValues schedules indexed by order-placement days 0..days. Supports split deliveries, purchasing constraints, per-SKU reviewIntervalDays and a shared cashReserve spending policy. Reviews start on day zero; off-review low-stock attempts defer without native POs or spending. Reports deferredPurchaseReviews and reviewDeferredRuns. Returns empirical percentiles, exact money means and unit fill rates, paired deltas, global and per-policy comparison conditions, path-diversity counts, daily cash and per-SKU inventory flows, first stockouts, minimum cash and reserve-blocked counts. Independent replay checks receipt timing and physical availability before sales as well as final balances. Each comparisonToBaseline lists changedConditions for capital, stock, prices, priority, reserve, horizon and realized paths. Optional per-seed goals include minCashBalance and productFillRates: unique {sku,minFillRateBps} targets present in every policy. Reports expose per-target checks and pooled service; all targets must pass on the same seed, and overall fill cannot hide a critical SKU miss. Zero-demand targets are not evaluable. At most 12 runs and 180 total product-days. Path matches do not establish equivalent assumptions, independence or confidence bounds. No live-store reads, real purchases or external services.

tools.name: simulate_inventory_plan
tools.description: Project demand, stockouts, sales, purchase orders, split receipts and cash through the real embedded engine in a private store. Supply demand ranges, history or an exact dailyUnits forecast schedule, exact costs and reorder policy. Lead times and first-delivery fills accept fixed values, ranges or dailyValues schedules with exactly days+1 entries for order-placement days 0..days. Optional purchasing sets reviewIntervalDays (1..60, omitted means daily), minimum quantities, case packs and an inventory-position cap. Reviews occur on day zero and interval multiples; off-review low-stock attempts defer with nextReviewDay and unchanged cash before sizing or financial checks. Reports deferredPurchaseReviews; orders recompute current stock on review days before whole-order cash. Optional plan cashReserve withholds shared cash without shrinking orders. Reports daily cash and inventory flows, first stockout, minimum cash, supplier methods and reserve-blocked attempts. Inventory replay checks projected demand, purchase/receipt identities, supplier terms, daily event ordering and physical availability before sales against final native balances. Native purchase lines, sizing constraints, stock, reserves, cash flows and financial values must reconcile. Conditional projections; no live store or supplier access.

tools.name: compare_inventory_plans
tools.description: Compare two or three inventory and purchasing policies using independent private embedded stores. The same seed, SKU and demand assumptions produce common demand paths across policy changes and product ordering. Returns exact metric deltas and global condition flags, plus each row comparisonToBaseline with changedConditions for opening cash, inventory, unit economics, purchase priority, cash reserve, horizon and realized demand/supply paths. Money is compared exactly; SKU facts are independent of product ordering, while purchase priority is checked separately. At most 180 product-days total; no real purchases or live-store writes.
